## Problem and resulting behaviour

Explain the business problem, the change and the resulting operator behaviour.

## Evidence

List the exact checks executed, their scope and any original evidence files. Separate local/synthetic results from actual provider validation.

## Operational impact

Describe changes to contracts, approvals, effect identities, migrations or recovery. Link unresolved acceptance gates rather than closing them with an implementation claim.

## Public repository safety

Confirm that the change and evidence contain **synthetic data only**, no credentials, live provider payloads or copied proprietary code. For security vulnerabilities use [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) instead of a public PR. State whether this changes the published release (normally it does not).
